crisis.button.draft: Manaʻomia se fesoasoani i le taimi nei

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: E lē na o oe. O loo iai pea i le pito i luga le faamau o loo taʻua i luga,  —  valaʻau pe text 988, po o le 911 i se faalavelave faafuaseʻi.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: E lē aofia i lenei lisi meaʻai po o fale e nonofo ai.

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: E lē gata i lea, e mafai foʻi ona e faia ni laasaga lē faavauvau i le uluaʻi 24 itula, pe a māeʻa ona iloiloina.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Ua faavasegaina au pepa aloaʻia. O se fuafuaga e totogi; e leai se tau ua faatulaga mai.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: E mafai foʻi ona e kiliki i le Manaʻomia se Fesoasoani i le taimi nei i le pito i luga o so o se lau.

reentry.call211.draft: Valaauga 211 mo punaoa i le lotoifale

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Saili se nofoaga saogalemu e nofo ai (valaau i le 211 po o nofoaga e maua ai fale i le lotoifale)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Saili meaʻai mo lenei vaiaso (valaau 211 po o se faleoloa o meaʻai i le lotoifale)

reentry.steps.step11.draft: Faasaoina le 988 ma le 911 i lau telefoni

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Ia tusi i se kalena aso uma o le faamasinoga ma taimi e asiasi ai

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Siaki au sala tupe, totogifuapauina ma tupe toe faafoʻi

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Ia lesitala i le Medicaid, ma le SNAP pe afai e te manaʻomia

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Ia siaki i lau ofisa le tulaga o lau faamalologa pe faamalolo i se taimi puupuu, a o leʻi talosaga.

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: E lē o faaalia ni numera o telefoni.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: E totogi le fuafuaga, ae e leʻi fuafuaina se tau.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: E leai se aogā o tupe o faailoga.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Sini ma fuafuaga sauniuni mo fale. E le saunia e Groundwork ni fale ma e le galulue faatasi foi ma kamupani. Mo se fesoasoani i le lotoifale, vili le 211.
